name: Speechify
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Speechify, read user-supplied documents aloud with a local TTS engine. The hard boundary is high-quality voice catalog, ocr, mobile capture, cross-device sync, and publisher partnerships, plus models, compute, rights, and safety operations.
